title: Labeled low-degree learner output
statement: For natural numbers $n,\ell,m$ and $m$ labeled samples from $\{\pm1\}^n$ with sign labels, convert each sample to its binary encoding and apply the low-degree sample solver. The resulting output is a coefficient assignment over $\mathbb{F}_2$ indexed by subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$.
